hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.toolCall.args.TargetFile // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ]; then ( cd "$d" && uv run ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ); fi ;; esac; echo '{}'
